headline: Sensex and Nifty Extend Weekly Gains Driven by FII Inflows and Lower Crude Oil Prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) buying supported market sentiment over the week.
Lower crude oil prices provided relief to Indian equity markets.
A retreat in global AI trade fueled a rotation trade favoring Indian equities.
Strong performance in smallcaps and PSU bank sectors boosted weekly benchmark gains.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty registered gains for the third consecutive week.
Smallcap stocks jumped 3.6% while PSU bank stocks surged 7.5% during the week.
Upcoming WPI inflation data, crude oil prices, and FII activity will guide market direction this week.
Total health insurance spending crossed 20% of total health expenditure in India.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended their weekly rally for a third straight week, backed by foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices. Smallcap and PSU bank stocks recorded strong gains, while a global rotation out of AI stocks benefited Indian equities. Market participants are watching WPI inflation data and FII trends for further cues.
